question_or_symptom: A few sizeof/offsetof probes can be read as a complete declaration of every upstream ABI field.
observation: The authority freezes 17 target layout sizes and selected key offsets, but explicitly marks each field map as key-offset-partial. The provider API preserves omitted fields as unspecified and tests only the recorded entries.
conclusion: Layout size authority and field-map completeness are separate claims and must not be conflated.
decision: Use the recorded sizes/offsets only for identity and compatibility probes; require a new complete-field probe before exposing a typed structure to a daemon adapter.
invalidated_assumptions: An incomplete field map is safe to use for arbitrary struct serialization.
Matching sizeof alone proves pointer-bearing field semantics.
